name: Palette from Image
summary: Extract a dominant color palette from any image — locally in your browser.
description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or BMP to pull out dominant colors with HEX/RGB values and share percentages. Copy individual colors, a HEX list, or CSS custom properties. Image data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: How are colors chosen?
faqs.answer: The image is downscaled, pixels are quantized into buckets, and the most frequent distinct colors are returned (with a minimum distance filter so near-duplicates collapse).

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Extraction uses Canvas in your browser only.

faqs.question: Why might transparent areas be ignored?
faqs.answer: Pixels below a mid alpha threshold are skipped so checkerboard / cutout edges do not pollute the palette.
